about: The pairing page (/account/pair.html), one reader across devices, step 1: its words and its Content-Security-Policy. Read by newsroom/build/features/pair.mjs (dev@PrompTugal.dinis, 17 November 2026).
title: Pair a device
summary: Join this browser to your other device: one shows a pairing code, the other reads it, and both screens show the same six-digit code. A dry run for now: nothing is sent.
md: One device shows a code; the other reads it (paste the text, or open the link). Both then show the same six digits: go on only if they match. The code is valid for ten minutes and works once.

**A dry run for now.** This page makes this device's key, shows and checks codes, and prepares the answer, but sends nothing: sending needs the vault access key, which is not issued yet. What is planned: [the spec](https://github.com/PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Website/blob/dev/board/spec-one-reader-across-devices.md).

**What stays on this device:** its key, which this page can use but never read or send; and the codes it has seen, until they expire. Nothing is stored anywhere else, and this page loads no counter or tracker.
no_js: The pairing page needs JavaScript: the keys are made and used in this browser.
